description:
Configure Screaming Frog SEO Spider's Custom Search to audit https://books.toscrape.com/ for content compliance. 

STEPS:
1. Go to Configuration > Custom > Search.
2. Add 3 rules to search Page Source:
   - Rule 'Buy Button': Contains text 'Add to basket'
   - Rule 'Availability': Contains text 'In stock'
   - Rule 'Price Format': Contains regex '£[0-9]+\.[0-9]{2}'
3. Start the crawl of https://books.toscrape.com/.
4. When complete, export the Custom Search results (from the Custom Search tab) to '~/Documents/SEO/exports/custom_search_results.csv'.
5. Write a summary report at '~/Documents/SEO/reports/content_quality_report.txt' that includes the total page count, counts for each search pattern found, and recommendations.

SUCCESS CRITERIA: A CSV export containing Custom Search columns with data, and a text report with numeric findings.
